description: Labelled regression bench. Every source URL was fetched on 2026-10-21 and checked (HTTP 200 + a key phrase on the page) before being listed. UNVERIFIED claims are vague or unverifiable by design and carry no source.

claims.claim: Schools in Hyderabad were closed on a single day because of Ganesh Nimarjan
claims.note: Telangana declared 25 September 2026 a holiday for schools and colleges for Ganesh idol immersion.

claims.claim: India's Chandrayaan-3 lander touched down near the Moon's south pole on 23 August 2023
Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal in men's javelin throw at the Tokyo Olympics
ISRO launched the Aditya-L1 solar mission on 2 September 2023
India won the 2024 ICC Men's T20 World Cup
In May 2023 the RBI announced it would withdraw the 2000 rupee note from circulation
The special status of Jammu and Kashmir under Article 370 was revoked on 5 August 2019
India hosted the G20 leaders' summit in New Delhi in September 2023
Two sadhus and their driver were lynched by a mob in Palghar, Maharashtra in April 2020
UPI, the Unified Payments Interface, was launched by NPCI in 2016
ALERT!! Gangs of child kidnappers are moving in villages at night dressed as sadhus and police. They take children and remove their kidneys. Forward to all groups!
claims.note: The organ-harvesting child-thief rumour that preceded the Palghar lynching.

claims.claim: Drinking cow urine cures COVID-19

claims.note: RBI press release on the validity of 10 rupee coins.

claims.claim: The new 2000 rupee note has a nano GPS chip for tracking

Drinking water every 15 minutes washes the coronavirus into the stomach and kills it

claims.note: The video was older footage of unrelated violence in Pakistan.

claims.claim: A viral video shows PM Narendra Modi dancing garba
claims.note: The man is a lookalike, Vikas Mahante. A MISLEADING verdict is also acceptable to a human reviewer; the bench counts only FALSE as a match.

claims.claim: Chandrayaan-3's lander crashed on the Moon in August 2023
claims.note: Fabricated for the bench: the lander made a soft landing.

claims.claim: India lost the 2024 T20 World Cup final to South Africa
claims.note: Fabricated for the bench: India won the final.
